info.name: JubeeX Scrutiny API
info.description:
Production APIs for the JubeeX backend.

**Flow**
1. POST /v1/filings (compiled or separate)
2. GET /v1/jobs/{{job_id}} until status=completed → copies agent_data_id
3. GET /v1/filings/{{agent_data_id}}
4. PATCH /v1/filings/{{agent_data_id}} with {"status":"approved"} if you want to mark it approved (no Llama UI)
5. POST /v1/filings/{{agent_data_id}}/scrutiny
6. GET /v1/jobs/{{job_id}} for the defect report

Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:8000) and `apiKey` if JUBEEX_API_KEY is enabled.
Do not wrap the body in `start_event`. Do not send `handler_id`.

request.description: Liveness. No auth. Does not run a workflow.
Returns filing_types, job_types, and split_upload slot ids. No workflow.

item.name: 1. Process filing
item.description: POST /v1/filings always enters process_file.py. job_type chooses the path.

request.description:
Runs **process_file.py** (classify + LlamaSplit a compiled PDF), then **process_split_files.py** (parse, extract, Agent Data, Pinecone).

Replace download_url with a real HTTPS/S3 URL. Poll until completed and read `agent_data_id`.
Saves job_id from the 202 response.

Poll `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}` until `completed` or `failed`. While working: HTTP 200, `status: "running"`, `result: null`. On failure: HTTP 200, `status: "failed"`, read `error`.

response.name: 202 Accepted
response.description: Immediate response. Copy `job_id` and poll GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}.

response.name: Poll in progress — GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}
response.description: Job is still working. HTTP is 200; keep polling. `agent_data_id`, `result`, and `error` are null. `completed_at` is null. Do not treat this as success. Poll again until `status` is `completed` or `failed`.

`filing_type` is required. Document `name` is mapped to a slot (01_Petition.pdf → petition).
There is no separate public URL for process_split_files.py.

request.description:
Fetches the Agent Data record. Extracted JSON is in `data`. Org/workspace/user/document ids are in `data.metadata`.
Does not run a workflow.

Sets Agent Data review status without the Llama UI.
Allowed values: approved, rejected, pending_review.
After extract the record is pending_review. Call this before scrutiny if the deployed image still requires approved.

item.name: 4. Scrutiny
item.description: Runs scrutiny_workflow.py against an extracted filing.

request.description:
Runs **scrutiny_workflow.py** (defect check).

Body is optional. You may send `file_hash`, `file_url` (`download_url`), both, or `{}`.
Do not send Swagger placeholders like `"string"`.
Filing status may be `pending_review` after extract; approval is not required.
Saves a new job_id. Then run **Get job status** again. Report is `result.report`.

Poll `GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}` until `completed` or `failed`. While working: HTTP 200, `status: "running"`, `result: null`. On failure: HTTP 200, `status: "failed"`, read `error`.
